subject: POC pricing: extra token allotment vs short extension
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan@novapulse.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-12T09:14:00Z
Subject: Ending POC next week — options?

Hi Soojin,

Quick one — our timeboxed evaluation ends next Tuesday and we've hit a higher-than-expected token burn. Two asks:

1) Can we get a short 10–14 day evaluation window extension to finish a final integration test?
2) Alternatively, can we purchase an incremental allotment (100k tokens) to finish the same work today? If so, what's the price and lead time for billing?

We'd prefer the token top-up if it's straightforward; extension is second choice. We're under a procurement review, so whichever keeps things moving fastest is best.

Thanks,

Evan
Director of ML, Novapulse AI

--
Attachment: POC-usage-report.csv (stated)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@novapulse.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-12T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Ending POC next week — options?

Evan — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the fast burn.

Two options we can offer today:

A) Short evaluation extension: 12 days at a 40% extension credit (applied as account credit toward hosted usage). No new invoice required; we just apply the credit and extend the evaluation window.

B) Incremental token allotment: 100k additional evaluation tokens for $1,200 (one-time prepay). We can process and invoice immediately; tokens applied to your org within one business hour.

Operational notes:
- Extension keeps you on the current evaluation config (no billing changes).
- Token allotment is fastest for immediate consumption; it will require a PO or email approval for billing.

I'll loop in Karthik to weigh in on margin/discount flexibility and Marissa for any finance constraints.

If you confirm which option you prefer, I'll get the paperwork ready (I can attach the invoice draft or issue credits).

Best,

Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

+1 415-555-0143

Soojin,

Recommend we prioritize the token allotment since Evan flagged procurement — tokens will avoid contract amendments and speed delivery. Margin note: we can authorize an extra 10% off the token price if Novapulse signs a 3-month pilot commitment for dedicated capacity (convertible credit toward Dedicated if they convert). That makes the 100k tokens $1,080.

If they push for the extension only, approve the 12-day 40% credit but require a short acceptance email acknowledging the extended window and scope.

I'll defer to Marissa on invoice flow.

- Karthik
Head of Sales Strategy
